import base64
F="/root/bot/bot/plugins/ai_chat.py"
s=open(F,encoding="utf-8").read()
def D(x): return base64.b64decode(x).decode("utf-8")
pairs=[("",""),("ICAgICMg5oqK5qih5Z6L5Zue5aSN6YeM55qEIEDmlbDlrZcg6L2s5oiQ55yf5q2j55qE6Im+54m55q61","")]
for i,(o,n) in enumerate(pairs,1):
    old,new=D(o),D(n)
    c=s.count(old)
    assert c==1, "锚点"+str(i)+" count="+str(c)
    s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(F,"w",encoding="utf-8").write(s)
import ast; ast.parse(s)
print("替换完成+语法OK")
